context_purpose: A partner vendor grants a staff rate only to people currently employed by the partner company.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting a badge photo, name and phone number on a sign-up sheet exceeds what a yes/no staff-rate check needs and is kept indefinitely.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: A current-employment token answers the discount question fully.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Vendor cannot contact the person or tie visits to an account unless it separately holds membership data.

transmission_check.reason: Voluntary hand-over to get a discount; no law requires the badge copy.

context_purpose: A landlord judges whether a prospective tenant will pay rent reliably.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full statements expose salary sources, medical payments and balances far beyond payment reliability.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: An on-time count is what the landlord wants, though it ignores income level and cash payments.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Income capacity, deposit ability and first-time renters or cash payers with no recurring transfer history.

transmission_check.reason: Tenant volunteers statements to win the lease; no rule found requiring them.

context_purpose: A landlord assesses whether a pop-up tenant can afford rent.

norm_violation_today.reason: Seller-center screenshots reveal customer orders, margins and suppliers the landlord has no role to see.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: Two thresholds roughly capture ability to pay but not profitability or seasonality.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Margins, costs and other sales channels that bear on actual affordability.

transmission_check.reason: Voluntary evidence offered to secure a lease; no legal duty.

context_purpose: A client plant lets in only dispatched workers still engaged by the agency, for access control and safety.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting ID numbers and contract copies into paper logs is plausible for a site register but excessive for a mere entry check.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: Fine for the gate check, but incident, insurance and headcount needs may want a named record.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Identification of who was on site after an accident, and accountability for individuals.

transmission_check.reason: Site safety and dispatch duties may require named records, but I cannot confirm the specific Taiwanese requirement.

context_purpose: A dealer or buyer wants assurance that a vehicle sale will not be blocked or burdened by the seller's unpaid fines.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full fine-lookup screenshot reveals dates and places of driving, which exceeds a clear/not-clear question.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: Non-membership answers the question, though fines can arise right after and the transfer office enforces anyway.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; the plate-linked fines are checked at transfer regardless.

transmission_check.reason: Private parties ask voluntarily; official transfer checks happen separately at the office and do not need the buyer to see a document.

context_purpose: A school or clinic confirms that an applicant lives within its catchment or programme area.

norm_violation_today.reason: A filed bill copy discloses exact address, usage and amount owed when only district membership is relevant.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: Catchment membership suffices for eligibility but not for contact, registration-address or tenant-versus-account-holder checks.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Exact address for contact, link between account holder and the applicant, and any household-registration requirement.

transmission_check.reason: Schools may be required to verify residence in specific ways, and I cannot confirm that rules accept anything but documents.

context_purpose: A fleet lessor or insurer gauges driver experience and stability to price a lease or policy.

norm_violation_today.reason: Trip logs with pickup and dropoff addresses and full income statements go well beyond tenure and volume.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: Volume and tenure are a weak proxy for risk; insurers price mainly on claims and violations.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Claims history, violations and driving quality, which drive actual risk pricing.

transmission_check.reason: Driver volunteers it for a better price; no legal duty to hand over platform data.

context_purpose: A gig or staffing platform avoids duplicate insurance enrolment by confirming the worker is already covered elsewhere.

norm_violation_today.reason: Requiring an ID copy with address and a letter naming the main employer is more than a coverage yes/no needs.

purpose_sufficiency.reason: An active-coverage flag settles duplicate enrolment, though regulators may expect the platform to confirm it via official records.
purpose_sufficiency.lost: Evidence the platform could keep to show it met its own insurance obligations.

transmission_check.reason: Enrolment of workers is regulated and the platform may have to verify through official labour-insurance records, which I cannot confirm.
